evals.prompt: Our Suigar frontend uses the compiled v1.2.2 GitHub archive. Add a thumbs-up capy; should I install npm beta and use gesture="thumbs_up"?
assertions: Inspects the archive declarations and keeps the pinned dependency unless migration is authorized
Uses historical capyGesture="thumbsUp" when supported by that archive
Does not claim the npm beta is published or require an unrelated upgrade

evals.prompt: On the ts-sdks migration source, create a standalone SVG with a custom accessory whose assetSrc points to a remote SVG.
assertions: Explains a remote assetSrc remains an external reference even with the inline renderer
Uses a self-contained SVG data URL for the override when offline export is required

evals.prompt: Using the ts-sdks migration checkout, show how to add a mirrored pink runner kit and a thumbs-down bullshark.
assertions: Uses a six-digit hex color and mirrorBib: true
Uses the shared gesture prop and thumbs_down only after checking it exists in the checkout
Does not promise unpublished source changes are available in the historical archive
